flavour: The Shaman points a bony finger at the enemy and utters a curse. Almost immediately, buckles begin to break and rivets pop, causing armour plates to slip.
effect: Remains in Play. Whilst this spell is in play, the target enemy unit must re-roll any Armour Save roll of a natural 6.

flavour: The Shaman begins vigorously scratching and cackling maniacally, their antics causing their enemies to feel uncomfortably hot and itchy.
effect: Until your next Start of Turn sub-phase, the target enemy unit suffers a -D3 modifier to its Toughness and Initiative characteristics (to a minimum of 1).
